info: Urgap will internally reformat this config into a simple dictionary (k, v[v'value']) available under urgap.config

umeta.description: Storage interface for meta data. Might require 3rd party installations

logging_level.description: Verbosity of urgap, can be set to any python logger level

update_resources.description: Define whether resources from the repo will be force copied into $URGAP_HOME on startup. This is useful if resources are developed in the urgap repo, yet code execution will use $URGAP_HOME/resource code.

update_uparma.description: Define whether uparma json download should be forced (part of u2 dev work). Not required for release

hash_algorithm.description: Hash algorithm used in Urgap in order to create unique identifiers

max_parallel_cores.description: Number of CPU cores to use for parallel processing.

umeta-mongodb-url.description: url for mongo instance, used if umeta is set to mongopdb. Login and password are extracted via ENV or alternative secret store defined in credentials_lookup.json

umeta-postgresql-url.description: url for postgresql instance, used if umeta is set to postgresql. Login and password are extracted via ENV or alternative secret store defined in credentials_lookup.json

umeta-sqlite3-url.description: url for sqlite3 db file, used if umeta is set to sqlite. Should start with file:///

mode.description: Mode in which urgap is running. Can be set to prod for stricter rules.

clean_scratch_at_exit.description: Urgap uses scratch <scratch_disk>/<wid> as temporary spaces. This flag will ensure that temporary directories (<wid>s) will be deleted when interpreter exits.

terminate_remote_servers_on_exit.description: Send a termination signal to all ports on localhost during urgap exit

opentelemetry_collector_url.description: Open Telementry Collector url, e.g. http://localhost:4317

opentelemetry_exporter_type.description: Open Telementry Exporter Type. Null will disable OTEL.
